## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] UI / design change (please attach screenshots)
- [ ] Documentation

## How was it tested?

<!-- Describe what you ran and on which platform (Windows / Linux / Docker). -->

- [ ] `npm --prefix ui run check` and `npm --prefix ui run build` pass
- [ ] `dotnet run --project tests/Core.Tests` passes (and other affected test projects)
- [ ] I tried the change in a running panel
- [ ] Affected docs / README / translations (English **and** German) are updated

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords or personal paths are included
- [ ] Permissions, input validation and the existing security model are respected
- [ ] I disclosed AI assistance where it was used substantially
